notes.title: 《The Joker's Game》Demo优化
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone[/p][p]The demo version has been online for some time. We have carefully listened to everyone's feedback and suggestions, and in this update, we have optimized some of the players' suggestions.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The update content is as follows:[/b][/h3][olist][*][p][u]The difficulty of mini-games has been reduced, including: Rubik's Cube and Chocolate Painting Candy.[/u][/p][/*][*][p][u]Solve the problem of abnormal resource reading during the loading process.[/u][/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]We will continue to optimize in the future and hope to present better content to everyone. Thank you very much for your support![/p]

notes.title: 《The Joker's Game》 is now available on Steam's New Releases Festival!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone! The first live-action interactive movie game of the battle royale genre, "The Joker's Game," has officially joined the Steam New Festival! [/p][p]Starting today, players can download and experience the complete storyline of the first chapter for free.[/p][p][/p][p]This test is a demo test. All the content you experience in the current version is still under development and does not represent the final quality and performance of the game when it goes live.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]The free trial DEMO is now available today![/b][/h2][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Common Test Questions:[/b] [/h3][p]Q: How do I download games? [/p][p]A: Go to the Steam store and search for "The Joker's game". Select the store page "The Joker's game" to download and enjoy the game. Or click the link： [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2983660/The_Jokers_Game/ "]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2983660/The_Jokers_Game/ [/url][/p][p][/p][p]Q: Is this test free? Can I still try it after the new product festival ends? [/p][p]A: This demo test is available for free download and play for all players. The trial period is relatively short. If you want to experience the full version, please pay attention to the official game version to be released later. [/p][p][/p][p]Q: How many chapters can I try out? How many chapters are there in total? [/p][p]A: The demo currently available includes the prologue and part of the first chapter. The product has a total of 5 chapters, and the full version will be more complete. If you are satisfied with the game, we hope you can support the product as much as possible. Even just adding it to your wishlist is a great encouragement to us! [/p][p][/p][p]Q: Will this demo test be reset? [/p][p]A: It will be deleted. To ensure the quality of the game, we will optimize many aspects before the official release. At that time, there will be significant changes to the game. [/p][p][/p][p]Q: How can I report bugs encountered in the game? [/p][p]A: You can click on the official social media links at the bottom of the announcement: leave us a message on Discord, X and YouTube. We will cherish every piece of feedback and correct it.
